entities.name: DLD O08749
observations: Supplied 509-aa sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed mouse mitochondrial dihydrolipoyl dehydrogenase (UniProt O08749).
EC 1.8.1.4; reoxidizes protein-bound dihydrolipoamide using NAD+ to produce lipoamide, NADH, and H+.
One FAD cofactor is bound per subunit; annotated as a homodimer and E3 subunit of several mitochondrial enzyme complexes.

entities.name: DLD sequence properties
observations: 509 residues; estimated molecular mass 54,271.7 Da, theoretical pI 7.99, GRAVY −0.0401; values are sequence-derived.

entities.name: Lipoamide dehydrogenase complexes
observations: DLD functions as E3 in pyruvate-, 2-oxoglutarate-, and branched-chain alpha-ketoacid dehydrogenase complexes, and is a component of the glycine cleavage system.
